candidates.explanation: The confirmation link for a changed email is built with the '/confirm-email' path, which is the same page used by the sign-up activation mail (userSignUp). That page calls the confirmEmail endpoint, which expects a confirmEmailUserId-only hash. The new-email hash holds newEmail, so the email change is never applied. The URL should use '/confirm-new-email', which calls the confirm-new-email endpoint.

fix.description: In MailService.confirmNewEmail, build the URL with '/confirm-new-email' instead of '/confirm-email'.
